verdicts.one_liner: Untouched gun-bruiser; nothing in this patch moves his slot.
verdicts.indirect: No meaningful indirect effects — Healbane's cap only matters to teams stacking it, and his grenade anti-heal is single-source. Graves' 56.5% snapshot is still unresolved and unpatchable here.

verdicts.one_liner: Celeste's nerfs soften her worst matchup; her own ceiling is unchanged.
verdicts.indirect: Celeste (42%, her worst listed matchup) loses silence duration, dagger range and ult slow/cooldown, so the burst that kills her pre-Fixation is weaker. Bullet Resilience and Return Fire still cap her.

verdicts.one_liner: Flat slot; Celeste relief is the only movement.
verdicts.indirect: Celeste (42%) takes a full-kit trim, easing the burst that beats her to the punch. No item or system touches her fire-rate gun core, and she still has no growth path.

verdicts.one_liner: Paige's lane cut helps; buffed M&K and Victor still tank his cage.
verdicts.indirect: Paige's base bullet 35→32 (~9%) softens his worst lane at 47%. Mo & Krill's Scorn 1.2x→1.3x and Combo 40→50 deepen the durable-frontline losses that already cap him.

verdicts.one_liner: Softer stacked anti-heal gives his regen shell room, but his worst matchups didn't move.
verdicts.indirect: Healbane's 4-stack cap 82.2%→72% eases the anti-heal tax on his sustain shell. Yamato (42%) and Drifter (44%), his two worst matchups, are untouched, so the gain is small.
build_adjustments: Keep Healbane as a single dedicated buy — don't ask an ally to stack it.

verdicts.one_liner: Her Healbane slot is worth less and Mo & Krill got harder to burst.
verdicts.indirect: The 4-stack anti-heal cap trims the team value of her Healbane slot in the on-hit spirit core. Mo & Krill's Scorn 1.2x→1.3x makes her worst tank matchup (42%) harder to close out.
build_adjustments: Treat Healbane as single-buyer; don't count on allies stacking it to open burst windows.

verdicts.one_liner: Untouched; still can't kill the tank front line.
verdicts.indirect: No meaningful indirect effects — the Healbane cap doesn't touch her burst, and the tanks she loses to (Billy, M&K, Victor) only got marginally better.

verdicts.one_liner: Celeste's nerfs help a little; the divers that actually beat her didn't move.
verdicts.indirect: Celeste (43%) loses silence duration, dagger range 30m→25m and ult slow/cooldown. Yamato, Lash and Holliday — the real reason she sits at 46% — are unchanged.

verdicts.one_liner: Mo & Krill's buffs deepen his worst matchup; his own core is flat.
verdicts.indirect: Scorn 1.2x→1.3x and Combo 40→50 sharpen the silence/combo lock that already beats him at 40%. His Healbane is single-source, so the item patch gives him nothing back.

verdicts.one_liner: Anti-heal package trimmed, but his own lifesteal gains roughly cancel it.
verdicts.indirect: Healbane's multi-source cap cuts the value of his Healbane + Toxic Bullets package when allies also buy it — but the same change cuts enemy anti-heal against his Spirit Lifesteal and Napalm T2. Celeste's nerfs ease a matchup he already wins.
build_adjustments: Keep Healbane as one dedicated buy in Dashfernus; don't double-buy it.

verdicts.one_liner: A-tier pick; Mo & Krill's buffs make one bad matchup slightly worse.
verdicts.indirect: Mo & Krill — a listed losing matchup — gets Scorn 1.2x→1.3x, Burrow radius +0.5m and Combo 40→50, making the lockdown frontline that punishes her commit harder to burst. Her pick targets (Haze, Paradox, Wraith, Mina) are all flat.

verdicts.one_liner: Anti-heal stacking got weaker; his spirit melee core is untouched.
verdicts.indirect: The 4-stack anti-heal cap trims the payoff of his Healbane + built-in heal-cut composition. His spirit melee core and his winning matchups (Pocket, Holliday, Shiv) are unchanged.
build_adjustments: Lean on the spirit melee core; keep Healbane single-source rather than a team slot.

verdicts.one_liner: Frontline sustain gets a small lift from weaker anti-heal stacking.
verdicts.indirect: The multi-source anti-heal cap (4 stacks 82.2%→72%) eases pressure on his Rising Ram/Lifestrike sustain, which was his listed counter. Shiv, his worst lane, is untouched.
